claims.claim: DPR's Wikipedia retrieval corpus contains 21,015,324 passages.
Passages were built from the English Wikipedia dump from Dec 20, 2018.
DrQA preprocessing code was used to clean the articles.
Semi-structured elements like tables and infoboxes were removed.
Disambiguation pages were removed during preprocessing.
Each cleaned article was split into disjoint 100-word text blocks.
Each block was prefixed with its article title.
Each block was prefixed with an [SEP] token.

questions: What is the size of the DPR Wikipedia corpus and how are the passages formed?
How many passages are in the DPR retrieval corpus and what is the splitting strategy?
Describe the preprocessing steps used to create the DPR Wikipedia passages.
